properties.notes: The site has the benefit of an Outline (14/02286/OUT) and Reserved Matters (17/02174/REM) Planning Permissions. | Part of the site is brownfield (Approx 60%) and part is greenfield (Approx 40%). | The brownfield element of the site is approximately 1.49ha, whilst the total site size is some 2.48ha. | It is anticipated that the brownfield component of the site has a capacity for approximately 29 dwellings, whilst the total site capacity is some 48 dwellings. | The site is considered deliverable. | The map shows the full extent of the site and not only the brownfield area.
